Dri_primary_resource_space.author_readme:
All the archives necessary to run the codes are in the folder 'Data'.

In the folder 'Data' you will find the tables (.csv) you need to run the codes. 

In the folder 'R codes' you will find the scripts to run the main analyses of the manuscript (survival and habitat selection).

Codes to run the kriging analyses can produce slighly different but qualitatively similar results.

Any questions please contact gabriela.franzoi at maine.edu
